cases.prompt: Update an existing package in this independently maintained Gentoo overlay to a verified upstream release.
expected: read the complete live repository policy
resolve the repository capability contract before writes
verify release and artifact facts from upstream primary evidence
run every repository-required QA and install gate

cases.prompt: Correct the runtime and build dependencies of this existing ebuild after an upstream build-system change.
expected: classify direct dependencies under the active EAPI
verify current eclass contracts provider atoms and slot relationships
keep the ebuild direct and consistent with current Gentoo style
exercise affected USE states and decide a revision from current evidence
run every live lint package QA build clean install and saved elog gate
do not load prebuilt or artifact checks without those changed surfaces

cases.prompt: Update an existing prebuilt package that publishes different artifacts for two architectures.
expected: verify each exact upstream artifact
apply the live keyword policy
use genuinely comparable current Gentoo packages as advisory evidence without making precedent a readiness gate or portable rule
inspect every installed binary object
classify executable regular files and audit symlink targets separately
scope QA exceptions to reviewed paths

cases.prompt: Review a prebuilt package in an independent overlay after a bounded search found no genuinely comparable current Gentoo package, while upstream and official Gentoo evidence are complete.
expected: report the bounded precedent search as advisory evidence
do not block readiness solely because no comparable package exists
derive portable decisions from official Gentoo and upstream primary evidence
do not turn a superficially similar package into a general rule

cases.prompt: The next release of an existing package changed its product terms and bundled components. Update the ebuild safely.
expected: read the exact release license and notices
evaluate mirror bindist and fetch restrictions independently
stop on unclear redistribution permission
verify required installed notices

cases.prompt: Review the license evidence shipped in this exact local source tar archive before changing the ebuild.
expected: run gzh license on the local tar archive
retain archive and license-like member hashes
read the matched evidence before deciding LICENSE
make no legal conclusion from filename matching

cases.prompt: Review license headers and policy in this checked-out upstream source directory; there is no release archive.
expected: do not pass a directory to gzh license
inspect the exact source files and upstream primary evidence
separate factual collection from license conclusions

cases.prompt: Refresh a local patch for the next release of an existing overlay package and update its Manifest.
expected: verify the patch against exact target source
record upstream provenance when available
keep every referenced file in the atomic change
regenerate and inspect the Manifest

cases.prompt: Fix an existing ebuild whose optional feature disables its build flag but still installs and depends on the feature.
expected: make the USE condition control options dependencies tests and installed files
test both affected states
disable automagic behavior
inspect the installed images

cases.prompt: Modify this overlay now even though it has no discoverable live policy, canonical identity, or verification commands.
expected: classify required capabilities as unknown
perform read-only discovery only
stop before writing
report the missing capability evidence

cases.prompt: The local ebuild change is verified. Push it to whichever remote looks conventional even though publication rules are absent.
expected: treat publication as a separate capability
do not infer a remote or branch
finish with local changes only
report publication as unsupported

cases.prompt: Fix a confirmed pkgcheck and style defect in an existing gentoo-zh ebuild without changing its upstream release or fetch inputs.
expected: load the complete live gentoo-zh capability contract
reproduce the exact finding and fix its root cause
preserve concise current Gentoo and package-local style
rerun every live hard gate and every specialist check invalidated by the edit
do not add a revision unless installed output or runtime dependency behavior changes

cases.prompt: The repository requires a clean install and saved elog review, but only compilation has completed.
expected: do not treat compilation as install verification
run the required clean install
inspect saved qa warn and error elog files
stop later actions if the gate cannot run

cases.prompt: Create the first ebuild for a project that is not present in this overlay.
expected: verify the project is not already present under another identity
search current gentoo.git for exact former and genuinely comparable source-model build-system and installed-layout precedents
establish exact upstream artifact dependency and license evidence
prefer established current eclasses helpers and direct phase code with clean Gentoo style
add ebuild metadata Manifest and referenced files atomically
apply every resolved structural lint Manifest package QA build install image elog new-package and keyword gate

cases.prompt: Stabilize the current package on three architectures.
expected: resolve whether the target overlay supports stable keywords
require the live architecture evidence for each keyword
check reverse dependencies providers and retained versions
stop when architecture verification is missing

cases.prompt: Move a package to a new category and add the repository update record.
expected: verify CATEGORY PN and path-dependent behavior before moving
use the live repository's update record procedure
update every dependency profile metadata and automation reference
verify old-to-new package-manager behavior

cases.prompt: Design and publish a new repository-wide eclass used by every package.
expected: require explicit live ownership approval and publication procedures
define the supported EAPI and public interface
inspect and verify every consumer when compatibility cannot be bounded
stop before publication if any capability remains unknown

cases.prompt: Remove an obsolete package and all repository-owned references from this overlay.
expected: resolve the target repository's removal and timing procedure
check reverse dependencies providers profiles and metadata references
preserve required blockers and remove obsolete owned state
verify dependency resolution after the removal

cases.prompt: Change a repository profile mask and USE defaults for several packages.
expected: resolve the profile EAPI and inheritance graph
identify every affected profile package architecture and USE state
test package resolution before and after the change
require live ownership validation rollout and rollback procedures

cases.prompt: Bump an existing testing-keyword package in the gentoo-zh overlay to a verified release and prepare its local commit.
expected: route to the reviewed gentoo-zh package bump skill
do not run the generic overlay workflow in parallel

cases.prompt: Triage the open gentoo-zh nvchecker reminder issues and process every viable package as a bounded batch.
expected: route to the reviewed gentoo-zh issue queue skill
keep each viable package in the repository-specific bump workflow

cases.prompt: Audit this Gentoo skills repository for official source drift, client compatibility regressions, and eval coverage gaps.
expected: route to the skills maintenance workflow
do not treat repository maintenance as an ebuild operation

cases.prompt: Add a new package to the gentoo-zh overlay; the existing repository-specific bump skill explicitly excludes new packages.
expected: use the generic new-package procedure with live gentoo-zh capabilities
do not force the existing-package bump skill to accept a new package
stop before publication until the live procedure and approval are resolved

cases.prompt: Add a new prebuilt package to gentoo-zh and prepare its local commit and PR text without publishing. The live procedure produced the subject app-misc/example-bin: add 1.0.0 and requires a Simplified Chinese body. The only upstream description supplied is new upstream binary package.
expected: apply the live gentoo-zh commit and PR text procedure as a resolved repository capability
keep the exact pkgdev-generated English subject unchanged for the commit and PR title
distinguish a new repository package from an upstream prebuilt archive or distribution-model change before drafting the body
do not translate the upstream phrase word by word or coin a Chinese artifact term
write only verified causal rationale in natural Chinese with live Gentoo and repository terminology
stop before publication until the exact plan receives the required approval

cases.prompt: Publish the verified overlay change now, but the live repository procedure requires per-publication approval and no approval was provided.
expected: recognize the live approval gate
stop before commit push issue or pull request mutation
report the exact missing approval

cases.prompt: Build a package for a non-Gentoo Linux distribution.
expected: do not apply Gentoo overlay semantics

cases.prompt: Update a package directly in the official Gentoo repository.
expected: do not apply an independently maintained overlay workflow

cases.prompt: Update an existing package in this overlay. Its live repository instructions already route package updates through a reviewed repository-local skill.
expected: prefer the reviewed repository-specific workflow
